description: Use when the person asks where things stand with the messages they sent to lawyers through ESQ CoPilot (up to 10, each with its private status_token). Returns each message's status from its record (recorded, queued, sent, delivered, responded, consultation_requested, consultation_confirmed, cancelled, completed, failed), the lawyer's decision, a timeline of what happened and who reported it, and counts. A consultation counts only when confirmed. Failed and cancelled messages are shown, never hidden. Stores nothing; sends no reminders. This is a listing service, not a lawyer referral service. No lawyer pays for placement or ranking of any kind.

brief_id.description: Optional CaseBrief id from prepare_case_brief, only to label the view

items.description: The person's own messages: contact_request_id and its private status_token, from send_client_message
